plain: A fee or tax charged on each pound

webster.text: A sum deducted from a pound, or a certain sum paid for each pound.

example.quote: It extends to duties on all kinds of goods, to tonnage and poundage of vessels, to duties on written instruments, newspapers, almanacs, &c.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 26, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
